note: 产品版本与发布记录（手工维护，随 git tag 发布）；管线数据快照另有每日滚动，不在此列。

summary.zh: DSH Insights 首个对外版本：DeepSeek Harness 全景观察站——插件健康 · 官方动态 · 生态趋势。
summary.en: First public release of DSH Insights, the DeepSeek Harness observatory: plugin health, official dynamics and ecosystem trends.

items.zh: 全量发现与校验：14,151 多源候选 → 10,189 权威插件（manifest 门禁逐条核验，断点续跑）
items.en: Full discovery and validation: 14,151 multi-source candidates → 10,189 authoritative plugins (item-by-item manifest-gate verification, resumable)

items.zh: 10,000+ 插件详情页：健康分 / 维度画像 / 扣分明细 / 同类推荐，全部静态生成
items.en: 10,000+ plugin detail pages: health score, dimension profile, deduction breakdown and peer picks, all statically generated

items.zh: 健康评分 health-v5：S–D 五级扣分制，含反模板农场规则（一次性导入 / 批量账号识别）
items.en: Health scoring health-v5: S–D deduction-based grades with anti template-farming rules (one-shot imports, batch-account detection)

items.zh: 生态洞察（LLM 分析）：规则引擎检出异常信号，DeepSeek v4-pro 撰写结论与建议，中英双语，每周五产出
items.en: Ecosystem Insights (LLM analysis): a rules engine detects anomaly signals, DeepSeek v4-pro writes conclusions and recommendations, bilingual, every Friday

items.zh: 生态周报：数据快照驱动，周五自动生成，支持 Markdown / PDF / PNG 导出
items.en: Ecosystem Weekly: snapshot-driven, generated every Friday, exportable as Markdown / PDF / PNG

items.zh: 动态时间线：插件新入库 / 版本升级 / 活跃更新 + 官方 release，按日分组、类型筛选
items.en: Dynamics timeline: plugin arrivals / version upgrades / recent activity + official releases, grouped by day and filterable by type

items.zh: 场景组合推荐（按「我想做什么」选插件）、作者榜与协作关系图
items.en: Scenario-based picks (start from what you want to do), author leaderboards and the collaboration graph

items.zh: 全站中英双语：跟随浏览器语言 + 一键切换 + ?lang= 可分享链接
items.en: Full-site zh/en i18n: follows browser language, one-click toggle, shareable ?lang= links

items.zh: 开放数据集首发（CC BY 4.0）：plugins.jsonl / enrich.json / insights.json / 周下载 / RSS / llms.txt
items.en: Open dataset debut (CC BY 4.0): plugins.jsonl / enrich.json / insights.json / weekly downloads / RSS / llms.txt

items.zh: 健康徽章：每插件 SVG badge 与接入指南（/badge/）
items.en: Health badges: per-plugin SVG badges with integration guide (/badge/)

items.zh: 管线自动化：每小时增量纳新 + 每日刷新 + 周五内容管线（周报/洞察/信件），GitHub Actions 全闭环
items.en: Pipeline automation: hourly incremental intake, daily refresh and the Friday content pipeline (weekly / insights / letters) — all on GitHub Actions
